# `⇄` — Inverse pair

`f⇄g` calls `f`. `(f⇄g)⁻¹` is `g⇄f`.

```bpl
f←{⍵+1}⇄{⍵-1} ⋄ f5            ⍝ 6
f←{⍵+1}⇄{⍵-1} ⋄ f⁻² 5        ⍝ 3
```

Dyadic inversion holds `X` fixed: `X g (X f Y)` must recover `Y`.

```bpl
f←{⍺+⍵}⇄{⍵-⍺} ⋄ 3 f⁻¹ 8       ⍝ 5
f←{⍺+⍵}⇄{⍵-⍺} ⋄ (3⍃f)⁻¹8      ⍝ 5
```

Left binding preserves the pair. For right binding, pair the bound monad: `(f⍄A)⇄undo`.

See [Power](power.qmd) and [Under](under.qmd).
